help.faqB1Q: What is Roua platform and how does it work?
help.faqB1A: Roua is a smart trading account linking and tracking platform that connects your accounts across different exchanges (like Binance and Alpaca) via secure API keys to monitor and analyze your portfolio performance. The platform does not execute trades directly but tracks your linked accounts and provides comprehensive AI-powered analysis using multiple AI models such as Gemini, Groq, and GLM-4. The platform offers advanced analytical insights, smart signals, risk analysis, and instant alerts on your account activity — all in an easy-to-use interface.
help.faqB2Q: How do I create an account on Roua?
help.faqB2A: You can create a free account in minutes by visiting the registration page and entering your email and a strong password. After registration, you'll receive a confirmation email to activate your account. You can also sign up quickly using your Google account. After activation, you can link your preferred exchange like Binance or Alpaca via API keys and start tracking and analyzing your portfolio immediately.
help.faqB3Q: What subscription plans are available and what are the differences?
help.faqB3A: We offer four subscription plans: Free with limited access to basic tools and the ability to link one exchange account with demo mode, Pro that allows linking up to 3 exchange accounts with smart signals and advanced analysis, Premium that adds advanced AI and linking up to 10 accounts with account performance tracking, and Institutional for professionals with unlimited accounts and full access to all features. Each plan differs in the number of linked accounts, daily signals, available AI models, and level of analysis provided.
help.faqB4Q: Can I use the platform without linking an exchange?
help.faqB4A: Yes, absolutely! You can use Roua without linking any exchange through Demo Mode. This mode lets you try all analysis and AI tools with virtual market data, helping you learn the platform and explore its features before linking your real account. When you're ready, you can easily link your exchange via the settings page while maintaining the highest security standards.
help.faqT1Q: How do I link a new exchange account?
help.faqT1A: To link a new exchange account, go to the settings page and select the 'Linked Accounts' section. Click 'Link New Account' and choose the exchange you want to link (like Binance or Alpaca). You'll need to create an API key from your exchange account with read and trade permissions only — make sure withdrawal permission is not enabled. Enter the API key and secret in the platform and the connection will be verified automatically. After successful linking, the platform will immediately start tracking your balance and open positions.
help.faqT2Q: How do I track my linked accounts' performance?
help.faqT2A: After linking your accounts, the platform provides a comprehensive tracking dashboard that displays all your linked accounts in one place. You can view total balance, profit and loss, open positions, and portfolio distribution across all exchanges. Interactive charts are available to track your portfolio performance over different time periods (daily, weekly, monthly). You can also compare the performance of your linked accounts across different exchanges and visually analyze your asset distribution.
help.faqT3Q: What API permissions are required to link my account?
help.faqT3A: To link your account, we only need Read permission to monitor your balance and open positions. Trade/Spot Trading permission is optional and is only used if you enable the auto-execute signals feature on your linked account. Most importantly, we never ask for Withdraw permission — the system automatically rejects any key that includes this permission. We recommend creating an API key dedicated to Roua only with the minimum possible permissions, and restricting the key to our IP address if the exchange supports it.
help.faqT4Q: How do I get alerts about my account activity?
help.faqT4A: The platform provides a comprehensive smart alert system that you can fully customize. You can set up alerts for price movements, balance changes, opening or closing positions, and reaching specific profit or loss targets. Alerts are available through multiple channels: in-platform notifications, email, and browser alerts. You can also enable AI alerts that notify you when unusual market patterns or potential trading opportunities are detected on your linked accounts. Alert management is available from the settings page in the 'Notifications' section.
help.faqA1Q: How does the AI Council work?
help.faqA1A: The AI Council is a unique feature that combines analyses from multiple independent AI models such as Gemini, Groq, GLM-4, HuggingFace, Ollama, and Bedrock. Each model analyzes the financial asset independently and provides its recommendation (buy, sell, hold) with confidence level and reasoning. The platform then calculates a consensus recommendation based on each model's confidence weight. This multi-model approach reduces bias from any single model and significantly increases recommendation accuracy compared to relying on a single model.
help.faqA2Q: What are Smart Signals and how do I use them?
help.faqA2A: Smart Signals are trading recommendations based on comprehensive AI analysis that combines technical indicators (RSI, EMA, MACD), market sentiment analysis, and price patterns. Each signal includes trade direction (buy/sell), confidence level, suggested entry point, stop loss, and target. You can enable instant notifications to receive signals immediately, or review them on the signals page. High-confidence signals (above 80%) are marked with a special badge and can be executed directly with one click if you have trading permission.
help.faqA3Q: Can I enable automatic signal execution?
help.faqA3A: Yes, you can enable automatic signal execution from the AI settings page if you're subscribed to a PRO plan or higher and have enabled trading permission in your API key. This allows you to set specific rules such as minimum confidence level for auto-executing trades, maximum position size, and daily loss limit. Importantly, trades are executed through your linked exchange account directly — the platform never holds your funds — we only link your accounts and do not act as a financial intermediary. We strongly recommend monitoring AI recommendations first to understand their style before enabling auto-execution.
help.faqA4Q: How does the Smart Scanner work?
help.faqA4A: The Smart Scanner monitors hundreds of trading pairs in real-time and analyzes them using AI algorithms to identify promising opportunities. The scanner evaluates each pair based on several factors including: trend strength, trading volume, momentum indicators, breakout patterns, and sentiment analysis. It then assigns each pair a Smart Score from 0 to 100 and ranks them by importance. You can customize scanner filters according to your preferences such as minimum score, timeframes, and target sectors.
help.faqS1Q: How does Roua protect my API keys?
help.faqS1A: We take API key security extremely seriously. All keys are encrypted using AES-256-GCM, one of the strongest encryption algorithms globally approved. Keys are stored encrypted in an isolated database and can only be accessed through trusted execution services. We automatically reject any key that has Withdraw permissions to ensure no party can withdraw your funds. Additionally, all key access operations are audited and logged in monitored security logs.
help.faqS2Q: Can the platform withdraw my funds from the exchange?
help.faqS2A: No, never! Roua does not have or request withdrawal permissions from your exchange account. We only use API keys with limited read and trade permissions, and never accept keys that include withdrawal or transfer permissions. This means your funds remain safe in your exchange account and cannot be withdrawn by anyone else even if your Roua account is compromised. We always recommend creating API keys dedicated to Roua only with the minimum possible permissions.
help.faqS3Q: How do I protect my account from hacking?
help.faqS3A: We provide multiple layers of protection for your account: First, two-factor authentication (2FA) via authenticator app or SMS that adds an extra security layer at login. Second, a suspicious login detection system that alerts you when access is attempted from a new device or location. Third, you can monitor and manage your active sessions and terminate any suspicious session immediately. Fourth, comprehensive encryption of sensitive data and periodic session identity verification every 15 minutes. We recommend using a unique, strong password and enabling 2FA immediately.
help.faqS4Q: What is the privacy policy and how is my data used?
help.faqS4A: We adhere to the highest privacy and data protection standards. Your personal data is encrypted and not shared with any third party without your explicit consent. We use aggregated, non-identifiable trading data only to improve our AI models' performance, and never link it to your personal account. You can export all your data at any time from the settings page, and you can request complete deletion of your data. We undergo regular security reviews and comply with international data protection regulations to ensure your information's safety.
help.faqP1Q: How do I upgrade or change my plan?
help.faqP1A: You can easily upgrade your plan from the settings page under the subscription section. Choose the new plan and the price difference will be calculated proportionally based on the remaining duration of your current subscription. Upgrades take effect immediately and you get all new features right away. Downgrades take effect at the end of the current billing cycle to ensure you benefit fully from the paid period. We accept payment via credit and debit cards, bank transfers, and major cryptocurrencies.
help.faqP2Q: Can I cancel my subscription at any time?
help.faqP2A: Yes, you can cancel your subscription at any time without any additional fees or penalties. Upon cancellation, your account remains active with current plan features until the end of the paid subscription period. After the period ends, your account is automatically converted to the free plan while retaining all your data and account tracking history. You can reactivate your subscription at any time in the future and regain all your previous features. We do not charge any hidden fees or auto-renew without your prior consent.
help.faqP3A: We offer a full refund within 14 days of purchase if you're not satisfied with the service. This applies to all subscription plans without exception. To request a refund, contact our support team via email or live chat with the reason for your request. Refund requests are processed within 3-5 business days and amounts are returned via the original payment method. We believe your satisfaction is our priority and want you to be completely confident in your investment in Roua.
